items.summaryZh: 贝尔曼对美国大奖赛上与加斯利的碰撞被罚10秒感到“相当震惊”，他认为这次判罚过于严厉，而这次碰撞最终也导致他退赛。

media.altZh: 贝尔曼不满与加斯利碰撞被罚10秒 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: “I couldn’t disappear” – Oliver Bearman rues “crazy” penalty for Pierre Gasly clash
items.summaryEn: Oliver Bearman says he was "pretty shocked" to receive a 10-second penalty for his collision with Pierre Gasly at the United States Grand Prix, feeling the penalty was harsh, and the clash ultimately led to his retirement anyway.
detailZh: “我无法凭空消失”——奥利弗·贝尔曼对与皮埃尔·加斯利碰撞被罚感到不满
在贝尔曼看来，他对加斯利的这次大胆超车被严厉处罚，而这次碰撞最终还是导致他退赛
奥利弗·贝尔曼表示，他在F1美国大奖赛上与皮埃尔·加斯利发生碰撞后被罚10秒，对此他感到“相当震惊”。
贝尔曼在奥斯汀站比赛首圈上升了两个位置，并在下一圈于13号弯从内线对第10位的加斯利发起进攻。
意识到差距正在消失，贝尔曼将两个车轮压上黄色的内侧路肩，但他的左前轮仍然碰到了阿尔派的侧箱；这次接触虽然轻微，却对两辆车造成了严重损坏，FIA干事因此对这位英国车手处以10秒罚时。
“说实话，我相当震惊，”贝尔曼说。“这充其量只是一次比赛事故。我觉得因为这件事被罚10秒有点冤，尤其是考虑到今年发生的一些事件要么没有被处罚，要么只罚了5秒。在我看来，鉴于当时发生的情况，对这类事件处以10秒罚时似乎太过分了。
“我觉得我的赛车有足够的部分并排，足以证明——或者说让我觉得——我应该获得一点空间，但并没有真正得到那个空间。我只被给了大约半个车宽。我爬上路肩试图避免接触，但我就是做不到。一旦我决定发起这个动作，我就无法凭空消失。我没有锁死轮胎，我没有失去任何控制，只是简单地在那个阶段我无法消失。鉴于所有这些事实，10秒的处罚太疯狂了。
“说实话，更具惩罚性的是我受了一点损伤。那是一次非常轻微的触碰，但它基本上松动了底板，然后在接下来的几圈里慢慢振动脱落，赛车就在不断恶化。我大概有五圈感觉非常好、一切正常，然后慢慢地、一步一步地，赛车越来越差，然后基本上就完蛋了。”
这次损伤导致贝尔曼在第11圈让队友埃斯特班·奥康通过。
“皮埃尔超越了我，但我仍然感觉相对有竞争力，”这位哈斯车手继续说道。“前面皮埃尔和后面埃斯特班之间的差距非常稳定；只有一秒多一点。
“但随后从一圈到下一圈，我们看到有东西从车上掉落。在第一赛段，我一圈到下一圈就损失了大约零点八秒。很明显，我突然从车上有一点损伤变成了车上有灾难性的损伤。
“我就说，‘我已经不在这个竞争行列了，我要让埃斯特班过去’。他正要超过去，我只是不想挡住他，因为那不是我来比赛的目的。我们作为一个团队比赛，努力击败奥迪，所以我一有机会就让他过去了。”
贝尔曼最终在第24圈因早先的碰撞直接退赛。“情况越来越糟，变得很危险，”他说。“我的意思是，赛车非常难以预测，除此之外，你知道，引擎和所有部件的里程数都很重要。”
与此同时，加斯利在方格旗挥动时以落后利亚姆·劳森八秒的差距守住了第10位，但他觉得与贝尔曼的碰撞让他无法挑战小红牛。
“那是一次轻微的接触，但它在我们底板右侧切掉了相当大的一块，比如底板前部和中部；我认为我们损失了接近10个（下压力）点，所以这确实让我们的下午变得不太轻松，”这位法国车手说。
“考虑到我们排在第10位，还算满意。只是，我本想知道如果没有那次损伤，对阵利亚姆会有怎样的可能。我们永远不会知道了。”
detailEn: “I couldn’t disappear” – Oliver Bearman rues “crazy” penalty for Pierre Gasly clash
Bearman’s bold move on Gasly was, in his view, harshly penalized – and caused his retirement anyway
Oliver Bearman says he was “pretty shocked” to land a 10-second penalty for his collision with Pierre Gasly in Formula 1’s United States Grand Prix.
Bearman gained two spots on the opening lap of the Austin race and made a move on 10th-placed Gasly on the next tour, down the inside in Turn 13.

Realising the gap was disappearing, Bearman put two wheels on the yellow inside kerb, but his front-left wheel still touched the Alpine’s sidepod; the contact, albeit tenuous, caused significant damage to both cars, and FIA stewards hit the Briton with that 10-second penalty.

“I was pretty shocked to be honest,” Bearman said. “If anything, it was a racing incident. I felt a bit hard done by for it to be a 10-second penalty as well, especially given some of the incidents that have happened this year that have gone either unpenalized or five-second penalty. Ten seconds for that type of incident seems very excessive in my opinion, given what happened.

“I felt like I had enough of my car alongside to justify, or to kind of feel like I earned a bit of space, and didn't really get that space. I was given maybe half a car width. I was climbing up onto the kerb trying to avoid contact, but I simply couldn't. I couldn't disappear once I decided to go for the move. I didn't lock up, I didn't lose any control, it was just simply I couldn't disappear at that stage. Ten seconds is crazy, given all of those facts.

“To be honest, the more penalizing thing was that I picked up a bit of damage. It was a very small touch, but it loosened basically the floorboard and that slowly vibrated its way off over the next few laps, and the car was just deteriorating. I had maybe five laps where I was actually feeling very good and everything was fine and then slowly, step by step, the car was getting worse and then it was game over basically.”
The damage led Bearman to let team-mate Esteban Ocon through on lap 11.
“Pierre overtook me and I still felt relatively competitive,” the Haas driver continued. “The gap was very stable between Pierre in front and Esteban behind; it was just over one second.

“But then from one lap to the next, we saw something fall off the car. And in sector one, I lost something like eight tenths to myself from one lap to the next. It was very clear that suddenly I went from having a bit of damage on the car to having a catastrophic amount of damage on the car.

“I just said, ‘I'm not in this race anymore, I'm going to let Esteban go’. He was coming past, I just didn't want to hold him up because that's not what I'm racing for. We're racing as a team to try and beat Audi, so I let him go at the earliest opportunity.”

Bearman eventually retired from the race on lap 24 as a direct consequence of the earlier collision. “It was getting worse, it was getting dangerous,” he said. “I mean, the car was very unpredictable, and on top of that, you know, mileage on the engine and all of the parts are important.”

Meanwhile, Gasly held on to that 10th position with an eight-second deficit to Liam Lawson under the chequered flag, but he felt the clash with Bearman had prevented him from challenging the Racing Bulls.

“It was a small touch, but it just took quite a big chunk out of our right part of the floor, like on the front of the floor and then the mid part of it; I think we were down close to 10 [downforce] points, so it didn't really make our afternoon very easy,” the Frenchman said.
“Pleased, considering that we were 10th. Just, I would have liked to see what would have been possible against Liam without that damage. We'll never know.”

items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff dismisses Helmut Marko's Russell theory: "He still has what it takes"
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫否认赫尔穆特·马克尔的拉塞尔理论："他仍有所需的一切"
梅赛德斯首席执行官认为乔治·拉塞尔可以从即将到来的一级方程式世界冠军失败中抹去一切
梅赛德斯一级方程式车队老板托托·沃尔夫驳斥了前红牛顾问赫尔穆特·马克尔关于乔治·拉塞尔在未能赢得世界冠军后无法东山再起的观点。
安东内利预计将在即将到来的墨西哥城大奖赛中加冕，除非出现特殊情况推迟他的加冕仪式。
随着梅赛德斯凭借全新的2026年规定占据领先，这为长期效力于梅赛德斯的拉塞尔提供了一个争夺世界冠军的绝佳机会，但这位英国人却一直被他的经验较少的队友所掩盖，他在年初连续赢得了五场比赛，从而掌控了积分榜。
拉塞尔在夏季休赛期后短暂地复兴了一段时间，但由于新车的操控问题和可靠性方面的不幸，这位27岁的车手从未看起来有可能击败安东内利，现在他面临失去第二名给法拉利的莱维斯·汉密尔顿的危险。
天空体育德国评论员、前红牛顾问赫尔穆特·马克奥，去年年底离开了该团队，他认为拉塞尔从20岁队友那里遭受的失败后无法再回来。
马克奥说：“拉塞尔不再是一号车手。”当安东内利在奥斯汀的美国大奖赛中赢得本赛季的第九场胜利时，拉塞尔以第八名的成绩完赛。
"安东内利显然已经取代了他的位置。我怀疑他是否还有机会再次获得世界冠军，或者在任何地方获得一号车手的地位。"
在墨尔本的开赛周末赢得胜利之后，乔治·拉塞尔在整个2026年都被他的年轻队友所掩盖。
赛后，沃尔夫驳回了马克的评论，坚持认为，有了清白的名声和更适合他驾驶风格的赛车，拉塞尔仍然可以争夺世界冠军。
"赫尔穆特，他是我的奥地利非好友，但我尊重他的意见，"沃尔夫说。"但我认为他在乔治的问题上是错的。乔治拥有所有的能力。我认为赛车不适合他。"
“我认为赛季初，当你觉得自己今年会一鸣惊人时，而另一边却有一个天才少年开始真正地削弱你的优势，这样的处境可能很难应对。”
“我相信，在新赛季，乔治，如果我们能给他一辆快速的车，他绝对有赢得冠军的能力。”
“所以，我认为忘记他在F2和F3中赢得的冠军，他的新秀赛季，以及他在卡丁车赛中的连续欧洲冠军，这些都太过容易了。”
安东内利在本周末的墨西哥站比赛中以123分的领先优势进入，剩下五场比赛还有125分可以赢得。如果拉塞尔能在赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道赢得比赛，安东内利只需要获得第九名就能成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。如果汉密尔顿获胜，这位20岁的年轻人只需要在第十名中获得一个积分就能达到目标。”
detailEn: Toto Wolff dismisses Helmut Marko's Russell theory: "He still has what it takes"
Mercedes chief is adamant George Russell can wipe the slate clean from impending Formula 1 title defeat to Kimi Antonelli
Mercedes F1 boss Toto Wolff has dismissed suggestions from former Red Bull advisor Helmut Marko that there's no coming back for George Russell from being beaten to the world title by Kimi Antonelli.
Antonelli is set to be crowned in the upcoming Mexico City Grand Prix barring exceptional circumstances delaying his coronation by one week.

As Mercedes hit the front with the all-new 2026 regulations, it provided long-time Mercedes driver Russell with a golden chance to fight for the world title, but the Briton has been largely overshadowed by his less experienced team-mate, who won five consecutive races at the start of the year to take charge of the standings.

Russell enjoyed a brief resurgence after the summer break, but through a combination of handling struggles with the new cars and bad luck with reliability the 27-year-old never looked liked to defeat Antonelli and he is now under threat of losing second to Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton.
Sky Germany pundit and former Red Bull advisor Helmut Marko, who left the outfit at the end of last year, believes there's no coming back for Russell from that defeat to his 20-year-old team-mate.
"Russell is no longer the number one driver." Marko said as Antonelli took his ninth win of the season in Austin's United States Grand Prix while Russell came home in eighth.
"Antonelli has quite ​clearly taken that spot from him. I doubt whether he'll ever have ​another chance at the world title or be given number one status anywhere."
Following an opening weekend win in Melbourne, George Russell has been shaded by his younger team-mate throughout 2026.
After the race, Wolff dismissed Marko's comments, insisting that with a clean slate and a car more suited to his driving style, Russell can still contend for world championships.
"Helmut, he's my Austrian not-so-buddy, but I respect his opinion," Wolff said. "But I think he's wrong on George. George has all the ability. I think the car doesn't suit him.

"I think that at the beginning of the season it's maybe difficult to cope with a situation where you're feeling like this is my year to come, and then you have this wunderkind [wonderkid] on the other side that starts to really chip away.
"And I believe that in a new season, George, if we provide him a quick car, he has absolutely what it takes to win a championship.

"So, I think it's a bit too easy to say, let's forget about all these years where he won in F2 and F3, his rookie years and the European championships back-to-back in karting, that's still all there."

Antonelli heads into this weekend's Mexico race with a 123-point lead on Russell and 125 points left to earn over the remaining five races. If Russell manages to win at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, all Antonelli needs is ninth place to become the youngest world champion in F1 history. If Hamilton takes victory, a solitary point in 10th would be enough for the 20-year-old.
keyPointsZh: 除非出现特殊情况，否则他的加冕仪式不会推迟
keyPointsEn: His coronation will not be delayed unless there are exceptional circumstances

items.titleZh: 阿隆索称三分之一F1车手水平“非常低”，是否合理？
items.summaryZh: 阿隆索在美国大奖赛被阿尔本撞击后退赛后，称F1围场中三分之一的车手水平“非常低”。他冷静而刻意地向媒体重复了这一说法。

media.altZh: 阿隆索称三分之一F1车手水平“非常低”，是否合理？ · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Is Alonso's brutal F1 driver claim justified?
items.summaryEn: After being taken out of the United States Grand Prix by Alex Albon, Fernando Alonso claimed that a third of the Formula 1 grid is of "very low" quality. He repeated the claim calmly and deliberately to the media.
detailZh: 三分之一的一级方程式车手水平“非常低”。这是费尔南多·阿隆索在其美国大奖赛被其中一位对手毁掉后，对部分竞争对手提出的指控。
阿隆索向广播和文字媒体重复了类似的说法，以明确表达他的信息。他表达时冷静而刻意，而非情绪化。
阿隆索很少浪费言辞，所以这不是一句随口说的话，即使他最终可能在墨西哥的周四收回这句话。
但这到底是否合理，他指的是谁，背后真正的原因是什么？
阿隆索主要感到沮丧，因为他认为自己被亚历克斯·阿尔本在11号左弯撞上他并毁掉阿斯顿·马丁赛车一半底板而剥夺了积分完赛的机会。
这是一场充满事故的比赛：奥利·贝尔曼撞上了皮埃尔·加斯利的阿尔派赛车，弗兰科·科拉平托——他在巴库撞掉了两辆车——自己打转撞上了阿维德·林德布拉德的尾部，后者在起跑线后还与塞恩斯有过一次惊险时刻，塞恩斯不敢相信这竟然不值得处罚。
阿隆索说他自己赛车的损伤让他每圈损失了“半秒甚至更多”，当他在封闭停车区跳出阿斯顿·马丁赛车看到损伤程度时，他对自己竟能完成比赛感到困惑。
他认为如果没有损伤，他本可以凭实力获得第九或第十名，并将此评为本赛季“迄今为止”最好的表现。
对阿隆索来说，空手而归格外令人沮丧，因为这本来可能是他原本惨淡的一年中难得的亮点。
我们见过他退赛，即便阿斯顿·马丁本田也找不到问题（https://www.the-race.com/formula-1/strange-fernando-阿隆索-subplot-aston-martin-weird-f1-form/），而现在他已将注意力转向其他被困在非最优赛车中的车手。
凭借他“非常低”的车手质量说法，如果指的是22名车手阵容的三分之一，我们可以推测阿隆索心中大约有七名车手，包括阿尔本。
赛会干事认定这是一起比赛事故，因为当阿尔本已经决心尝试超越阿隆索时，阿隆索也在对埃斯特班·奥康的哈斯赛车采取行动，因此可以预见三辆车挤进一个弯道以糟糕结局收场。
阿尔本的2026赛季可能是他作为威廉姆斯车手最弱的一个赛季，但他的表现仍然远高于“非常低”的水平，并且在2022至2025年的大部分时间里都是中场车手中的佼佼者之一。
阿隆索的阿斯顿·马丁队友兰斯·斯特罗尔想必被排除在外，理由是阿隆索就在三年前还称他为潜在的世界冠军。
被哈斯车队放弃的车手埃斯特班·奥康和承受压力的瓦尔特利·博塔斯也可能是候选人，但两人都是久经考验的大奖赛分站冠军得主，奥康是阿隆索更具竞争力的队友之一，而博塔斯则是在梅赛德斯与刘易斯·汉密尔顿搭档时拿下10场分站胜利的人。
科拉平托在奥斯汀的周末表现不佳，但他在马德里是与兰多·诺里斯竞争周末最佳车手的人。
新秀林德布拉德进入第三节排位的次数，比四大车队之外任何车手都多；而排名垫底的塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯则稳居凯迪拉克车队更强车手之列，并在红牛经历艰难的最后一年后重建了自己的声誉。
因此，发车区上几乎看不到任何“非常低”质量的迹象，这意味着阿隆索的说法即使经过最简短的审视也完全站不住脚。
事实上，F1发车区的质量可以说从未像2026年这样高。这与不久前相当一部分发车区由主要靠资金支持获得席位的车手组成形成了鲜明对比。
发车区后三分之一的事故频率更高，但这是因为车手们在开场圈更密集地挤在一起，需要奋力拼抢才能接近积分区，而除非发生灾难，前四大车队基本锁定了前八个位置。
这正是贝尔曼提到的他为何要对加斯利采取那次冒险动作的确切原因，也是塞恩斯在威廉姆斯车队接连发生一系列事故的同一个原因——他在法拉利的四年里几乎没有发生过这种事——因为他不得不拼命挣扎才能从一辆糟糕的赛车中榨取到任何东西。
费尔南多·阿隆索不该沦落到队尾，为偶尔的一分而苦战，但卡洛斯·塞恩斯、弗兰科·科拉平托或塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯也不该如此。或者说，发车格上的任何一位车手都不该如此，他们都已经证明过，在状态好的时候，自己可以是最棒的。
看看塞恩斯在法拉利的胜利、兰斯·斯特罗尔在棘手的伊斯坦布尔条件下拿到的杆位、佩雷斯在红牛击败马克斯·维斯塔潘的那些周末，或者奥康是如何把看似不可能的匈牙利胜利变成现实的（还多亏了阿隆索的帮忙！）。
所以很难不把这句话看作一个标志，说明阿隆索对于自己仍然远远落后于其天赋应得的位置有多么沮丧。
这就是为什么他如此渴望阿斯顿·马丁本田车队能把他从发车格的后三分之一区域拉出来，可以理解；在那个区域，即使车手再有天赋，你也总是更有可能在比赛结束时两手空空，要么丢失一半底板，要么没有丢失。
detailEn: A third of Formula 1’s grid is “very low” quality. That was the charge Fernando Alonso levelled at some of his rivals after one of them wrecked his United States Grand Prix.
Alonso repeated similar claims to the broadcast and written media to make his message clear. He was calm and deliberate in his delivery rather than emotional.
And Alonso is rarely one to waste his words, so this wasn’t a throwaway remark, even if it’s one that he might end up walking back on Thursday in Mexico.
But is it at all justified, who is he referring to and what’s really behind it?
Alonso is primarily frustrated because he believes he was robbed of a points finish by Alex Albon clattering into him at the Turn 11 left-hander and destroying half of the Aston Martin’s floor.

It was an incident-packed race: Ollie Bearman clobbered Pierre Gasly’s Alpine, Franco Colapinto - who took out two cars in Baku - spun himself off the back of Arvid Lindblad, who also had a lairy moment with Sainz off the start line that Sainz couldn’t believe didn’t merit a penalty.

Alonso says the damage to his own car cost him “half a second or more” per lap, and he was baffled how he’d been able to finish the race when he saw the extent of the damage when he jumped out of the Aston Martin in parc ferme.
He thinks he could have been ninth or 10th on merit without the damage and rated this as “by far” his best performance of the season.
It’s doubly frustrating for Alonso to walk away with nothing when this could have been a rare highlight in an otherwise miserable year.

We’ve seen him retire from races even when Aston Martin Honda can’t find an issue (https://www.the-race.com/formula-1/strange-fernando-alonso-subplot-aston-martin-weird-f1-form/) and he’s now turned his attention to other drivers stuck in sub-optimal machinery.
With his ‘very low’ driver quality claim, we can assume Alonso has around seven drivers in mind if it’s a third of the 22-driver grid, including Albon.

The stewards deemed this to be a racing incident as Alonso was also making a move on Esteban Ocon’s Haas when Albon had already committed to trying to overtake Alonso, so predictably three cars into one corner ended badly.
Albon’s 2026 season has probably been his weakest as a Williams driver, but he’s still performing well above ‘very low’ quality and was one of the standout midfield drivers for much of 2022-2025.
Alonso’s Aston Martin team-mate Lance Stroll is presumably ruled out on the basis that Alonso labelled him as a potential world champion just three years ago.

Axed Haas driver Esteban Ocon and under-pressure Valtteri Bottas could also be candidates, but both are proven grand prix winners, with Ocon one of Alonso’s more competitive team-mates, and Bottas someone who took 10 race wins as Lewis Hamilton’s Mercedes team-mate.
Colapinto’s Austin weekend was poor, but he was competing with Lando Norris to be the standout driver of the weekend in Madrid.

Rookie Lindblad has had more Q3 appearances than any other driver outside the top four teams, and last-in-the-standings Sergio Perez has firmly been the stronger Cadillac driver and rebuilt his reputation after a bruising final year with Red Bull.
So there are very few signs of any ‘very low’ quality on the grid, meaning Alonso’s claim falls completely flat against even the briefest scrutiny.

In fact, the quality of F1’s grid has arguably never been higher than in 2026. It’s a stark contrast to a good portion of the grid not so long ago being made up of drivers who primarily earned their seats through financial backing.

There is a higher frequency of incidents in the lower third of the grid, but that’s because drivers are more bunched up on opening laps and needing to scrap hard to get anywhere near the points, when, barring disaster, the top four teams have the first eight positions on lock.

It was the exact reason Bearman cited for why he went for the ambitious move on Gasly, and it’s the same reason Sainz has had a string of incidents with Williams - having had very few in four years at Ferrari - because he’s having to fight hard to get anything out of a poor car.

Fernando Alonso doesn’t deserve to be back of the grid, scrapping for the odd point, but neither does Carlos Sainz or Franco Colapinto or Sergio Perez. Or really any of the drivers on the grid, who have all proven, on their day, they can be the best.

Look at Sainz’s Ferrari wins, Lance Stroll’s pole position in tricky Istanbul conditions, Perez’s Max Verstappen-beating weekends at Red Bull, or how Ocon converted his against-the-odds Hungary victory (with Alonso's help!).
So it’s hard to see this remark as anything more than emblematic of how frustrated Alonso has become that he’s still languishing nowhere near where his talent deserves to be.

It’s why he’s understandably so keen for Aston Martin Honda to haul him out of the lower third of the grid, where, even with talented drivers, you’re always more likely to end race empty-handed, half your floor missing or not.
keyPointsZh: 阿隆索认为阿尔本在第11弯的撞击毁掉了阿斯顿·马丁赛车的一半底板，导致他失去积分完赛的机会。
阿隆索表示赛车损坏让他每圈损失“半秒或更多”。
keyPointsEn: Alonso believes Albon's Turn 11 collision destroyed half of the Aston Martin's floor, costing him a points finish.
Alonso said the damage cost him "half a second or more" per lap.
